ex: This report is an acknowledgement of the size of the problem.
这个报告承认了问题的严重性。

zh: （澳大利亚）土地声明（在公开场合如大会、庆典活动和议会上正式承认澳大利亚土著居民为传统意义上的土地所有者）
en: (in Australia) an act of formally recognizing the traditional Aboriginal owners of the land at an event such as a conference or festival, and in Parliament
ex: The event started with an Acknowledgement of Country by one of the organizers.
该活动以组织者之一对国家的感谢开始。

en: American Civil Liberties Union

工程成就的顶峰

en: a skin condition, common among young people, that produces many pimples (= spots), especially on the face and neck
ex: to suffer from/have acne
患痤疮；长粉刺

en: a person who follows and helps a leader
ex: the Emperor’s faithful acolytes
皇帝忠实的侍从

声学上完美的音乐厅
